privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.body:
This policy explains what information Familist CPS Family Advocate ("Familist", "we") collects through cpsfamilyadvocate.com and how it is used.

Information we collect

  • Consultation and training requests: your name, email address, phone number and preferred contact method.
  • Free guides and newsletter sign-ups: your first name, email address and the role you select.
  • Payments: handled entirely by Stripe. We never see or store your card details; we receive confirmation that a payment succeeded.
  • Analytics: only if you accept cookies, Google Analytics collects anonymous usage information such as pages visited and device type.

Please do not include details about your case in website forms. Case information is discussed privately during your consultation.

How we use it

  • To contact you about your consultation, enrollment or request.
  • To send the guides or newsletter you asked for. You can unsubscribe at any time.
  • To understand how the website is used and improve it (analytics, with your consent).

We do not sell your personal information.

Cookies

Essential storage is used to remember your cookie choice. Analytics cookies are set only after you accept them in the cookie banner, and you can change your choice at any time using the "Cookie settings" link in the footer.

Third parties

We use Stripe (payments), Google Analytics (optional analytics), and WhatsApp or Spotify when you choose to open those services. Their own privacy policies apply to information you share with them.

Retention and your choices

We keep contact information only as long as needed for the purpose it was collected. To access, correct or delete your information, email us at the address on our Contact section.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.body:
By using cpsfamilyadvocate.com you agree to these terms.

Our services

Familist provides educational, advocacy, consultation and clinical support services for families, caregivers and professionals involved with child welfare systems. We do not provide legal representation or legal advice.

Bookings and payments

  • Consultation and training fees are shown on the website and charged in U.S. dollars through Stripe.
  • After you book, we will contact you to confirm a consultation time.
  • If you need to reschedule or cancel, contact us as early as possible. Refund requests are reviewed case by case.

Website content

Articles, guides, podcast episodes and other materials are for general information only and are not a substitute for advice about your specific situation. Laws and agency practices vary by state and country.

No emergency service

This website is not monitored around the clock. If a child is in immediate danger, call 911 or your local emergency number.

Changes

We may update these terms from time to time. The date above shows the latest version.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.body:
This service provides educational, advocacy, and clinical support using a familist, trauma-informed approach. It does not offer legal representation or legal advice. Services are designed to support parents, caregivers, and families navigating CPS processes in conjunction with legal counsel where applicable.

Information on this website is general in nature. Rights, procedures and timelines differ between states and countries; consult a licensed attorney in your jurisdiction about your legal options.

Clinical services are provided within the scope of the clinician's professional licenses. Outcomes described on this website are not a guarantee of results in any individual case.
